projection_rules.unit_catalog_ref: Only this named field resolves to a durable authority-scoped unit-catalog handle. Never expose or recursively scrub source paths.
projection_rules.physical_index_ref: Only keyframe_visual/segment_visual/asr_text/ocr_text physical_index_ref fields map to immutable member handles; preserve null OCR.
projection_rules.hash_identity: manifest_sha256 remains the original local canonical identity; the containing ArtifactRef.sha256 hashes this portable projection. They are distinct hashes; resolving the owned handles must reproduce the original manifest identity before use.
projection_rules.owned_handle: Server-issued unguessable capability lookup bound to principal authority, workspace, exact member manifest digest and generation. Stored durably; revocation/lease expiry rejects use; strings alone convey no permission.
projection_rules.limits: Maximum4MiB encoded payload; reject overflow before returning a reference; never drop members.
projection_rules.invariants: Preserve constructor checks for member workspace/corpora/unit hash, target types, embedding-space equality and member pin/manifest digests; JSON Schema alone does not establish these relationships.
projection_rules.binary_mask: Versioned mask payload represents canonical C-order nonzero predicate of original numeric array, preserving shape and all foreground bits. Product(shape) must equal foreground length, empty shape means scalar, any zero extent means empty. Maximum1million elements and32dimensions; reject overflow, wrong shape, or arbitrary executable/pickled arrays. Reconstruct bool ndarray; this preserves binary_mask_iou nonzero semantics exactly.
projection_rules.native_knowledge_lineage: Artifact contains exact native prepare_source lineage dictionary, discriminated by adapter. All6source branches preserved including sampled visual coverage and nullable audio, no path fields exist. source_sha256/representation IDs retain original immutable evidence identity; resolve artifact under same authority. No runtime qualification inferred from receipt presence; validate referenced profile/model hashes against trusted registry.4MiB payload limit, source200page/1hour/120frame caps unchanged.

ProtectedDiagnosticTextV1.description: Exact source diagnostic text, separately authorized confidential artifact; never inline or logged. Oversize fails before mutation when possible; post-effect oversize records reconciliation-required rather than dropping diagnostic evidence.

lifecycle_rules.registration: Proposed durable registry stores PublishedRegistrationRecordV1 before returning registration_ref. Authority digest binds full tenant/principal/client/audience/workspace/scope identity; TTL and state are checked on each use. Never deserialize PublishedGenerationRegistration. Reopen verified root by retained handle, verify manifest bytes/hash and workspace/corpus/profile, then call register_published to reconstruct a fresh runtime-owned token. Restart/reconstruction preserves registration identity and original published_at; mismatches reject, not mint replacement.
lifecycle_rules.qualification: Resolve report/policy/verification_receipt ArtifactRefs only from the trusted operator verifier store; verify matching generation/manifest/profile and unrevoked receipt issuer/version. Client hashes do not authorize qualification. Server sets verified_at, propagates bounded operation deadline, and calls the source issuer. Unavailable issuer fails; registering or issuing never activates. Returned qualification_id is source issuer identity, not human acceptance.
lifecycle_rules.activation_cas: Compare full seven-field ActiveGenerationSnapshot atomically in source lifecycle activate. Null means no existing alias. Reject stale snapshot even when generation_id matches; version fences ABA. Authority workspace/profile and registered publication must match qualification target. Approval binds operation schema/version, full request digest, resource manifest and expected snapshot. Recheck approval/policy epoch immediately before commit; same idempotency key+request returns recorded result, differing digest conflicts.
lifecycle_rules.pagination: Inspection starts a bounded durable snapshot of authorized collection entries ordered by stable root handle. Cursor is opaque server-generated signed/encrypted locator for InspectionCursorRecordV1, never client JSON. Persist snapshot page data/hash; max1000entries/page and4MiB/page, total snapshot storage budget configured before scanning. Pin collection revision and authority/policy epoch; reject expired or mismatched cursor, preserve stable offset without rescanning changed directory. Cannot create complete snapshot within budget => resource_exhausted, no silent omission.
lifecycle_rules.cleanup: Proposed composition requires durable CleanupActionReceiptV1 journal and exclusive mutation fence shared with activation AND lease acquisition. Atomically compare plan authority/policy epoch, collection revision, active pointer revision, lease revision and expiration; every member must be superseded with zero live leases and exact immutable manifest/root handle. Reserve deletion under fence and fsync journal before unlinking through retained directory handles. Do not release fence between eligibility check and deletion; mark evicted and persist terminal journal. Crash after delete_started => effect_uncertain/reconciliation_required; retry reconciles authoritative storage/catalog before progressing, never blindly repeats deletion. Existing can_evict/record_eviction alone do not implement this guarantee.
lifecycle_rules.inspection_reason: Preserve five GenerationDirectoryInspection members: root -> opaque root_ref, state/id/hash unchanged; raw reason -> allowlisted reason_code and protected diagnostic artifact if exact detail is required. Never expose raw exception paths in Tool result.

EmbeddingVectorsV1.layout: Row-major IEEE754binary64 little-endian components, no padding/header; row_count and dimension supplied by hash-bound result descriptor; byte length exactly8*row_count*dimension.
EmbeddingVectorsV1.validation: All finite; each row L2 norm squared within source absolute tolerance1e-5 of1.0; image output exactly1row; texts output exactly input text count. Reject mismatch before publishing. Encoding preserves Python source float precision; no float32 downcast.
EmbeddingVectorsV1.lineage: Artifact hash binds bytes; result includes model_id,model_revision,device,dimension,row_count,encoding. Store descriptor+artifact atomically under operation authority.
